verdict.rationale: Teller documents a dedicated sandbox environment that uses simulated data and never connects to real financial institutions. Its sandbox guide provides scripted test flows, such as an OTP MFA flow with a fixed code, so integrations can be tested without touching production data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox use, and documentation of which API resources (e.g. payments, webhooks) behave fully in the sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: The sandbox environment uses simulated data and never connects to real financial institutions.
Will follow an OTP MFA flow whereby the user will be asked to select a contact to send an OTP code. The correct code is `0000`
